title: Notion Start Agent fix
summary: Start Agent works again in Notion AI after Notion's latest site update.
improved: Each Notion chat thread is tracked separately, so new chats no longer reuse an older chat's session.
Large Notion startup messages are written safely without freezing the tab, with a chunked fallback for slow editors.
fixed: Notion Start Agent sends the startup command list automatically instead of leaving it in the chat box.
Notion's new /ai landing page and New chat button are recognised again.
Notion draft checks read emoji and smart quotes the way Notion displays them.
PlazCode finds Notion's send button even when its label changes, and never overwrites text you typed yourself.
notes: Start Agent was confirmed on a live Notion account (Windows, Chrome, AgentScript). Other AI sites are unchanged.
Automated platform/browser regressions passed. Live Roblox Studio imports were not re-tested.

sections.title: 🛠️ Notion Start Agent fixed
items: **Startup:** the command list now sends itself after Start Agent instead of staying in the chat box.
**New Notion layout:** the /ai page, chat threads and New chat button are recognised again.
**Draft checks:** emoji and curly quotes no longer make a complete message look changed.
**Safer writing:** large messages no longer freeze the tab, and text you typed is never overwritten.

sections.title: 🧪 Checks
items: Start Agent was confirmed on a live Notion account. Platform/browser regressions passed. Other AI sites are unchanged.
